name: getdents64
synopsis: ssize_t getdents64(int fd, void *dirp, size_t count);
description: The getdents64 system call reads multiple directory entries from the file descriptor specified by fd into the buffer pointed to by dirp. The count argument specifies the size of the buffer.

parameters.name: dirp
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to hold the directory entries

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Size of the buffer in bytes

return_value.success: Returns the number of bytes read, or 0 on end of directory
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Argument points outside the calling process’s address space
File descriptor does not refer to a directory

examples: int fd = open(argc > 1 ? argv[1] : ".", O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY);
ssize_t nread = syscall(SYS_getdents, fd, buf, BUF_SIZE);
for (size_t bpos = 0; bpos < nread;) { struct linux_dirent *d = (struct linux_dirent *) (buf + bpos); ... }
